provenance.author: Primary project assistant; no predictions for these cases inspected before label creation
provenance.purpose: Authored stress diagnostic, not an independently human-annotated benchmark or natural speech
provenance.label_definition: Personal degradation, insult or abusive dismissal of another person is positive. Criticism of a claim/policy, reported abuse without endorsement, self-deprecation and respectful disagreement are negative. Context-dependent items are excluded from primary metrics.
provenance.limitations: The author knows the project design and previous aggregate results; this is not a blind independent annotation. Some opening examples deliberately repeat known probes as regression cases.

interval_caution: Wilson intervals describe these authored cases under an iid approximation; they do not quantify generalization to natural conversations.
